messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands - can someone capture the concrete reasons we won vs lost in Q1 and the top asks for product/ops? Keep it tactical.
Arjun (Product): Short summary from product reviews: wins = predictable latency, easy onboarding, transparent benchmarks. Losses = pricing confusion for bursty usage, a couple of model regressions on summarization, and delayed SSO in some POCs.
Sasha (Sales): Pricing was the biggest objection in 4 deals. Mid-market felt Dedicated commit was too rigid. Also some customers misunderstood Flex billing as per-request not per-token.
Leo (PM): Proposed asks (draft): 1) Mid-market burst tier (monthly cap + burst), 2) Billing UX + sales one-pager, 3) Accelerate SSO/OIDC for Private. We should pick owners.
Sean (CS): From support: customers tried aggressive 4-bit quantization without guidance and hit quality cliffs. Need a short best-practices doc + example prompt set showing failures vs safe patterns.
Maya: Leadership ask: assign owners and timelines by next Friday. Prioritize one quick win + one medium project.
Arjun (Product): Owner suggestions: Leo -> pricing proposal & calculator (low-effort), Sasha -> sales-facing billing one-pager (low-effort), Sean + Eng-ML -> quantization guidance + evals (medium), Eng-Platform -> SSO rollout (medium).
Sasha (Sales): I'll draft the one-pager and include exact objection language from lost deals. ETA: Wed.
Leo (PM): I'll mock the burst tier calculator for the console and a simple revenue-bucket estimator. ETA: Fri.
Sean (CS): I'll assemble a quantization checklist, example prompt sets, and a small fallback-model recommendation. ETA: next Tue.
Eng-ML-bot: Created GH issues: #4901 billing-one-pager, #4902 burst-tier-calc, #4903 quant-guidance.
Maya: Add a rough expected impact bucket (small/medium/large) to each roadmap card so sales can prioritize outreach.
Arjun (Product): Adding impact buckets now. Also request: run quick postmortems on 3 specific lost deals to extract exact decision triggers. Sasha to assign.
Sasha (Sales): Assigning 3 deals now, will include verbatim customer quotes.
Leo (PM): Ops request: include fallback model recommendations in docs so customers can degrade gracefully when using quantized variants.
Sean (CS): Will include config snippet examples and a tiny JSON example: ```json
{"model":"redwood-mini-q4","fallback":"redwood-base-f16","max_tokens":512}
```
Maya: Great. Please drop status updates here when you hit ETAs. We'll review at the next all-hands. :thumbsup:
Sasha (Sales): Will post progress. :+1:
Leo (PM): Dropping roadmap card and linking GH issues.
Arjun (Product): I'll circulate consolidated actions with owners after syncing with Eng-ML.
Sean (CS): Starting quant examples, pinging Eng-ML for test harness.
Eng-ML-bot: Reminder set: follow-up ping in 7 days.
